settings.heading: Common questions.
settings.lede: Answers to the questions we get most often. Can't find yours? Send us a note.

settings.question: What is a DTF transfer?
settings.answer: DTF (Direct to Film) transfers are custom prints on a special film that you heat-press onto garments. They work on almost any fabric — cotton, polyester, nylon, blends — and produce vibrant, full-colour results with a soft feel.

settings.question: Do I need special equipment?
settings.answer: A heat press gives the best results, but a household iron works for small jobs. Set to 150°C, press for 15–20 seconds, peel, and press again for 10 seconds. Full instructions ship with every order.

settings.question: What's the minimum order?
settings.answer: There is no minimum. Order as few as one transfer or one garment. We cater to individuals, small businesses, and bulk orders equally.

settings.question: How fast is shipping?
settings.answer: DTF transfers ship within 24 hours of order. Custom garments take 5–7 business days. We ship NZ-wide via NZ Post with tracking on every order.

settings.question: What file format do you need?
settings.answer: PNG with transparent background at 300 DPI minimum is ideal. If you're unsure, send what you have — we'll optimise it for print at no extra charge.

settings.question: How durable are the prints?
settings.answer: Our DTF transfers are rated for 100+ washes. They stretch and rebound without cracking, fading, or peeling. Wash inside-out on cold for best results.

settings.question: Can you print on dark garments?
settings.answer: Yes. DTF includes a white underlay layer, so colours print bright and accurate on black, navy, charcoal, and any other dark fabric.

settings.question: What's a gang sheet?
settings.answer: A gang sheet is a single A3 transfer film packed with multiple designs of any size. You get more prints per dollar — perfect for bulk orders or testing multiple designs at once. From $11 per sheet.

settings.question: Do you do bulk garment orders?
settings.answer: Yes — t-shirts, hoodies, polos, hi-vis, caps, bags. Bulk pricing kicks in at 25+ pieces. Get a quote with your specs.

settings.question: Can I get a sample first?
settings.answer: For first-time bulk orders, we'll send one sample at no charge so you can confirm the quality before committing. Send us a note via the contact form.

settings.question: What's your return policy?
settings.answer: If a transfer is defective or not as ordered, we replace it at no charge. Custom-printed items can't be returned for change-of-mind, but we'll always make it right if something is wrong on our end. See Shipping & Returns.

settings.question: Do you offer rush turnaround?
settings.answer: Standard DTF turnaround is 24 hours. Same-day production is available for urgent NZ orders — call or email and we'll see what's possible.

settings.heading: Talk to a real human.
settings.sub: We answer email within hours during business days. No call centres, no script.
